outcome: Number of astrocyte glia cells in the cerebrum
cohort: 30 pregnant Rattus norvegicus were divided randomly into three experimental groups.
finding: Newborn Rattus norvegicus exposed to qari and qariah recitation during pregnancy had significantly higher numbers of astrocyte glia cells in the cerebrum compared to the control group, with qariah recitation leading to the highest numbers.
gest_age: Pups delivered at 18 days of pregnancy
